output.name: Tekma — The Oil-Spitter
output.myth: Tekma nests on the high ledge above the landing, where the rock gives under a hand. She is grey and heavy with fish, and she keeps her oil in her gut the way a wife keeps salt in a jar. Once Aun, all rope and no sense, climbed past her ledge to see what lay over the top. Tekma turned and spat her oil into his hair. It stank for a month. Aun laughed, which is why he never learned to be sorry. Tavo laughed too and tried to blow the stink away, but it would not go. Halun the Full Beak, a hand-span west of her, saw it all from the cold water. When Aun cut the string and the sky drifted off, Tekma went up with the other kites. Tamel, the Child's Kite, hangs east of her, where Tavo took a child's boat past the rocks. She is still up there in the Reach. So when a child goes up the cliff, the old ones say: mind Tekma. She has not forgotten Aun, and she will not forget you.
output.finding: Find Halun, the Full Beak, and go a hand-span east of it; Tekma sits there, just short of the full span, in the Windward Reach.
